projection.interpretation: Current vectors were projected into radial and tangential movement relative to the center of the spatial sample.
limitations: Vector projections describe mathematical movement relative to the center of the sampling field only.
Positive radial movement is inward and negative radial movement is outward.
Positive tangential movement is clockwise and negative tangential movement is counterclockwise.
No convergence, divergence, shear, current edge, rotation, eddy, persistence, habitat, or biological significance is inferred.

gradient.interpretation: Opposing current samples were compared to measure radial, tangential, and total horizontal velocity change across the spatial field.
limitations: Vector projections describe mathematical movement relative to the center of the sampling field only.
Positive radial movement is inward and negative radial movement is outward.
Positive tangential movement is clockwise and negative tangential movement is counterclockwise.
No convergence, divergence, shear, current edge, rotation, eddy, persistence, habitat, or biological significance is inferred.
Gradient values are finite-difference measurements across the north-south and east-west opposing sample axes.
The analysis describes horizontal surface-current variation within the sampled radius only.
Radial asymmetry, opposing radial support, tangential change, and total vector change are reported separately.

sourceVsDerived: Retaining finite source truth is distinct from licensing each downstream scientific use.
numericFailureVsMissing: Different conditions; no permission to relabel arithmetic failure as provider missingness.
captureContract: Available-source capture requires finite u/v/speed/direction. Actual partial available point rejected; unavailable-state partial schema diagnostic accepted. Capture is not responsible for every future calculation.
replayContract: Exact replay preserves accepted bytes; diagnostic replay can recreate invalid derivatives. Determinism does not confer scientific admissibility.
historicalEvidence: Do not rewrite old u/v, derived values or identities; preserve ambiguity.
publication: Nonfinite scientific content is rejected by strict copy/exact serialization. Snapshot retention before rejection does not qualify admission.
